name: Saitou Natsumi
source:
Hobbies: Reading, internet shopping
Likes: [url=https://www.google.com/search?q=%E3%83%AF%E3%82%A4%E3%83%89%E3%82%B7%E3%83%A7%E3%83%BC&rlz=1C1AVNG_enFI696FI696&oq=%E3%83%AF%E3%82%A4%E3%83%89%E3%82%B7%E3%83%A7%E3%83%BC&aqs=chrome..69i57&sourceid=chrome&ie=UTF-8]Wide na Show[/url]
Dislikes: Neighborhood gossip

A newlywed who has moved into the residential area of ​​Chisakura.
Although still newly married, she lives alone because her husband is very busy.
She enjoys reading, especially complex romance novels.
Occasionally, she goes for drinks at a bar near Chisakura Central Street.
